sources.title: Groupon laying off nearly 25 percent of its workforce in AI shift | Jefferson City News-Tribune
sources.description: Groupon, the Chicago-based online marketplace, is slashing up to 400 positions -- nearly a fourth of its worldwide workforce -- in a plan to rebuild as an AI-native company.

sources.title: Groupon layoffs hit HR, customer service and tech teams amid AI restructuring
sources.description: The online marketplace plans to cut up to 400 jobs globally as it redirects investment towards AI systems, automation and operational restructuring.

sources.title: Groupon cuts another 500 employees in second round of layoffs | TechCrunch
sources.description: Groupon has laid off another 500 employees in a measure to cut costs, the company said in an SEC filing last week.
